device_rule: Compare baseline and candidate on the same physical iPhone, OS build, configuration, content bytes, refresh setting and run conditions. iPhone 14 is the authorized current validation target; it is not the original symptom phone.
statistics: Nearest-rank percentiles over all valid samples; never discard a slow sample. Record failed operations separately and fail acceptance if any operation fails. One uncounted warm-up per warm batch only.
measurement_rule: Interaction starts at native touch-up and ends at first presented readable content frame. XCTClockMetric tap-to-accessibility readiness is an automation upper-bound proxy, reported separately and never substituted for touch/frame timing. A trace with missing frame data is incomplete, never zero hitch. Fresh-process is not device/filesystem cold. Original symptom reproduction is a separate statement requiring that original device.
